description: Small OSv2-focused follow-up PRD created after the previous integration PRD completed. Recent GitHub CI on this branch and main is green; no PR CI auto-fix context or LLM review auto-fix context is present. Scope is limited to three high-value, verifiable reliability/security gaps.

userStories.title: Mask JSON-decoded Vertex share-link graph payloads
userStories.asA: Vertex graph share-link viewer outside the owning organization
userStories.iWant: shared graph payloads decoded from JSON to have node property values masked
userStories.soThat: cross-org and unauthenticated views expose topology without leaking sensitive object data

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Vertex graph payload decoded from JSON where nodes are []any values containing map[string]any node objects
acceptanceCriteria.when: MaskGraphPayload is applied for a masked share-link response
acceptanceCriteria.then: each node property value is replaced with the mask token while structural fields such as graph name and node id remain unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.given: the same decoded graph payload is retained by the caller
acceptanceCriteria.then: the original decoded payload is not mutated

verification: Targeted Go regression test for JSON-decoded share-link graph masking.

userStories.title: Reject whitespace-only Vertex Model Mesh IDs
userStories.iWant: model IDs that are blank after trimming whitespace to be rejected
userStories.soThat: planner output cannot contain invisible node identifiers that corrupt DAG debugging and UI rendering

acceptanceCriteria.given: a model mesh request containing a model id made only of spaces or tabs
acceptanceCriteria.when: the plan endpoint builds topological layers
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is HTTP 400 with InvalidParameter:id and the graph is not planned

acceptanceCriteria.given: a model mesh request containing normal non-empty model IDs
acceptanceCriteria.then: existing layered topological behavior is unchanged

userStories.title: Treat share-link expiry at the boundary as gone
userStories.iWant: share links to stop working exactly at their expiry timestamp
userStories.soThat: time-boxed access grants do not stay readable for the expiry instant

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Vertex graph share link whose expiresAt equals the request time
a Vertex graph share link whose expiresAt is after the request time
acceptanceCriteria.then: same-org viewers still receive ReadOnly and other viewers receive Masked
